titleText: 32 local councils had financial records auditors could not fully verify, report finds
mainText: From The Malta Independent: 32 local councils had financial records auditors could not fully verify, report finds. Thirty-two local councils received qualified audit opinions for 2025 because auditors could not verify certain aspects of their financial statements due to insufficient supporting documentation, according to the Auditor General’s annual report on local government.

titleText: UĦM threatens industrial action at Transport Malta over unpaid wages, opposes privatisation proposal
mainText: From The Malta Independent: UĦM threatens industrial action at Transport Malta over unpaid wages, opposes privatisation proposal. UĦM – Voice of the Workers has registered an industrial dispute with Transport Malta over reports that employees have not received their full wages, giving the authority until Monday afternoon to settle the outstanding amounts or face industrial action from 1 December.

titleText: Health minister, Opposition's health spokesperson appeal to MAM to use point-of-care testing
mainText: From MaltaToday: Health minister, Opposition's health spokesperson appeal to MAM to use point-of-care testing. Health Minister Ian Borg and shadow minister Stephen Spiteri have appealed to medical stakeholders to engage in a discussion that will eventually lead to the use of point-of-care testing (POCT).
